digest.component_or_area: rebar review CLI command and library operation
propositions: rebar review must forward to rebar review-plan as a deprecated alias while preserving read-only semantics by passing --no-sign=True to suppress attestation signing
rebar review must reject --graph and positional reviewer_id arguments with exit code 2 and error messages naming review-plan as the replacement

The public library function rebar.llm.review_ticket must be split into _review_ticket_impl (no warning) and a public wrapper (emits DeprecationWarning) so that internal call sites in evals and diff harnesses do not double-signal deprecation
Three deprecation registry entries must be created for cli:rebar review, lib:rebar.llm.review_ticket, and mcp:review_ticket, all scheduled for removal in v1.0.0
rebar review on a non-claimable ticket (closed/blocked/idea) must exit with code 2 without calling the LLM, diverging from the old verb's behavior and documented in help
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS must be repointed so review maps to plan_review_verdict, and review_ticket schema is wired under a synthetic key to support the surviving library/mcp surface
